newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: Ghanaian president to visit Trinidad.
newsitem.headline: Ghanaian president to visit Trinidad.

text.p: PORT OF SPAIN, Trinidad, July 25, Reuter - Ghana President Jerry Rawlings will pay a three-day state visit to Trinidad and Tobago from August 5, Foreign Affairs Minister Ralph Maraj said on Friday.
The invitation, extended by Prime Minister Basdeo Panday, was approved at Thursday's Cabinet meeting.
Maraj said the leaders of the two countries are expected to sign a scientific and technical pact and a cultural co-operation accord.
Rawlings, the first Ghanaian leader to visit Trinidad, will be accompanied by his wife and three ministers.
